decisions.quote: In this point, Weeks et al. ( 1996 ) and our study differ from Stoffer’s ( 1991 ) original findings. Stoffer ( 1991 ) found the modulation of the local Simon effect by target presentation mode only when two small boxes served as precues. In addition, our study revealed generally larger local Simon effects for two small boxes as precue than for one large box, a pattern that was not reported by Weeks et al. ( 1996 ), but mirrored Stoffer’s findings (Stoffer, 1991 ).
decisions.reason: The authors do not state an overall failure verdict and explicitly frame their results as partly consistent with and partly deviating from Stoffer (1991), replicating the larger local Simon effect for two small boxes over one large box and the absence of a local Simon effect for the large box under simultaneous presentation while diverging on the four-way interaction and the presence of concurrent global Simon effects.

decisions.quote: The present experiment aimed to directly replicate Stoffer’s ( 1991 ) study, which extended the earlier work of Umilta & Liotti ( 1987 ). Stoffer ( 1991 ) investigated both global and local Simon effects under simultaneous and sequential target presentation, using two distinct reference objects as external precues: a large box and two small boxes. Consistent with Umilta & Liotti’s findings ( 1987 ), Stoffer ( 1991 ) observed only a local Simon effect for sequential target presentation when two small boxes were employed as reference objects, whereas no (local or global) Simon occurred for the large box as reference object. Weeks et al. ( 1996 ) previously failed to replicate these findings.
decisions.reason: Weeks et al. (1996) is an earlier replication attempt of Stoffer (1991) cited as background context and compared in the discussion; the present study's design, sample-size calculation, and procedural parameters directly re-test Stoffer (1991) rather than Weeks et al. (1996).
